name: RSS: schedule a Social Poster post when a new blog article appears

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps you schedule a Social Poster post when a new article appears in your blog RSS feed. The RSS trigger checks the feed at the interval you set and starts only for a new item. The next step builds the post text from the title and summary, keeps the article link, and adds your Social Poster account reference. Social Poster then creates a draft, schedules it at least five minutes in the future, and confirms it for publishing. The team API key cannot publish immediately. If your team requires approval, the post waits in Social Poster under “Waiting for you” until someone confirms it. The trigger remembers items it has already seen in this n8n instance; after a fresh install, an item may run again.

### Setup
This template uses the unverified community node `n8n-nodes-social-poster` (tested with version 0.1.1). It runs on self-hosted n8n only, not on n8n Cloud. Install it under Settings → Community Nodes → Install, package name `n8n-nodes-social-poster`. Guide: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
In n8n, create a “Social Poster API” credential. Create the key in Social Poster under the account menu → AI access → API key for n8n. Set the base URL to `https://app.social-poster.io` without `/mcp`.
In “Set post fields”, enter your account reference (typically `acc_…`) and the minutes until publishing (at least 5). In the RSS trigger, set your feed URL. Select the credential on “Schedule the post”, run one test item, and activate the workflow only when the text looks right.

### Customization
You can shorten the text, add hashtags, or put publicly reachable image URLs in Media URLs. To review first, switch the last node to Draft → Create. Leave “X Content Reviewed” off until a person has checked the exact text and media for X (Twitter).

## Detect a new article
The trigger starts only for a new feed item. Set your feed URL and poll interval here.

## Build the post
Enter the account reference and the lead time in minutes. Title, summary and link come from the feed.

## Schedule and confirm
The node creates the draft, schedules it and confirms publishing. The minimum lead time is 5 minutes.
Review posts for X (Twitter) in Social Poster yourself. Leave “X Content Reviewed” off until someone has checked the exact text and media.
